returns._0: URI string (data URI with JSON, or HTTPS URL)

contractURI(address).notice: Returns contract-level metadata URI per ERC-7572

counter().notice: The counter pool extension this renderer reads buy/sell trades from.

historyAssetName().notice: Optional Scripty content name for a static "history" bit-stream         prepended to the live counter data. Used to seed the new L1         token's animation with the trades that happened on the         predecessor (Base) Liquidity Layer pool. Empty = no history.

imageOverrideUri().notice: Optional override for the JSON `image` field. If non-empty,         it's used verbatim as the metadata JSON's `image` value         (e.g. "ipfs://bafkrei…" for a high-quality static thumbnail).         If empty, the renderer falls back to a `data:image/...;base64,`         URI built from the on-chain Mona asset. The animation_url's         canvas backdrop ALWAYS uses the on-chain Mona so the rendered         HTML stays self-contained regardless of this setting.

initialSupply().notice: Initial supply (in wei units, before decimals) used to compute         total burned = `initialSupply - token.totalSupply()`. Set to         the supply at deploy time. Zero = skip the burn line.

monaAssetName().notice: Scripty content name for the Mona Lisa image bytes.

monaMimeType().notice: MIME type of the asset stored under `monaAssetName` (e.g. "image/jpeg").

nameOverride().notice: Optional name override for the JSON `name` field. Empty falls         back to `IRenderableToken(token).name()`.

projectDescription().notice: Description text used in the metadata JSON. Rendered as the         first line; the renderer appends a newline + "Total burned: N         <symbol>" when initialSupply is non-zero.

scriptyBuilder().notice: ScriptyBuilderV2 (canonical address on mainnet, sepolia, base, etc.).

scriptyStorage().notice: ScriptyStorageV2 (canonical address; same on every chain we care about).

sketchScriptName().notice: Scripty content name for the LL sketch JS (loaded as         `<script src="data:text/javascript;base64,...">` via tagType 2).

supplyDecimals().notice: Decimals to apply when formatting the burn amount as a human-         readable integer. Defaults to 18 to match the standard ERC20         convention used by the launcher's ArtCoinsToken.

symbolOverride().notice: Optional symbol override for the JSON `symbol` field. Also used         as the unit suffix in the burn line of the description. Empty         falls back to `IRenderableToken(token).symbol()`.
